config.ranking: 100 * count(previous SKEW closes <= current close) / 104; current excluded; main requires every prior 104 calendar weeks; audit uses last 104 reported observations
config.range_points: maximum ES high minus minimum ES low across all following h weeks
config.range_percent: 100 * range_points / first observed ES open in next calendar week
config.direction_percent: 100 * (last observed ES close in h-th next calendar week / entry open - 1)
config.volatility: sample standard deviation of last 20 observed daily close-to-close percentage returns, including final signal-week close; not annualized
config.volatility_band_boundary: left inclusive, right exclusive; final band >=3
config.matching: other rank/volatility-eligible signal weeks in same signal calendar year and same volatility band, with complete same-horizon outcome; exclude own week; may include same SKEW group; minimum 1 peer; unmatched excluded only from matched comparison
